workflow.logging_policy: Snapshot-only: keep docs/project-state.json <= 8000 bytes, task summaries <= 320 chars, and <= 6 evidence items (<= 240 chars each). Never append historical daily benchmark logs.

current_capabilities.geometry_and_vector: Analytical curves/arcs, adaptive flattening, cubic/quadratic intersections, dynamic offset/contour, OSnap & inference engine, Pen tracing with Shift-only angle snapping and auto-commit to Node tool, direct segment bending (BendSegment) & multi-node curve conversion, Live Corners with compact 2x2 property bar, interactive direct canvas dragging for Round/Scallop/Chamfer corner types with single-step undo batching, Contour and Dimension controllers.
current_capabilities.document_and_color: Immutable snapshots, single-writer transactions, Undo/Redo, per-document and per-page independent CMYK/RGB color modes, mixed-color objects on single page, batch color conversion (convert entire file, active page, or selected objects to CMYK/RGB with full Undo/Redo), Select Same color picking (Select Same Fill Color, Stroke Color, Fill & Stroke, Color Space, CMYK/RGB-only, or by color value; integrated into Edit menu and right-click context menu), Soft-Proofing (Ctrl+Alt+Y), Gamut Warning (Ctrl+Shift+Y), Overprint Preview (Alt+Shift+Ctrl+Y), Black Generation (Pure K100 text/line art vs Rich Black C40 M30 Y30 K100), TAC limit clamping (ISO 12647-2 <= 320%), RGB/CMYK/Spot + Linear/Radial Gradient paint, appearance effect graph.
current_capabilities.rendering: Windows ViewportRenderer uses Direct2D 1.1 / D3D11 hardware or WARP; full-frame staging/readback writes BGRA directly for GDI. Target/staging bitmaps are reused by size; object-local geometry survives pan/zoom, image uploads are bounded to 64 images/256 MiB. ICC preview and white page rendering are connected. SpatialIndex culls snapshots; DamageTracker limits GDI dirty copies. SoftwareRasterizer supports BGRA as CPU fallback/oracle; viewport guard is 32 MP.
current_capabilities.desktop_shell: Win32 Native Shell uses a shared DIP coordinate space for painting and hit testing, physical-resolution canvas targets, and WM_DPICHANGED font/cache/window updates. Page resizing preserves Undo/Redo; tool previews and per-tab save paths have regression coverage. Dirty tabs checkpoint every 60s under LOCALAPPDATA/PikDraw/Recovery with isolated per-session paths; successful save cleans only that tab.
current_capabilities.automation_ecosystem: Shared typed AutomationService; MCP Streamable HTTP hosted in the desktop process. Current NativeWindow E2E verifies AC01 600x300 mm Vietnamese layout/font/margins/colors/icons, stable IDs, edit/undo after reopen, 5x2m design, Settings revoke/stale-endpoint, read-only denial and AC05 traversal save/open denial with no document mutation. AC02 RPC verifies atomic undo/redo IDs; AC07 RPC verifies 1,000-object stable-ID paging and stale continuation rejection. AC03 stale-write, active text-draft rejection and queued close/reopen write rejection preserve local edits, draft, revision and replacement document; Pen/effect drafts remain open. AC09 verifies dirty-tab create/open preservation, fallback warning and saved R vs dirty R+1; simultaneous save/edit remains open. COM registered STA/MTA GetTools/CallTool smoke and HKCU cleanup pass. Copy URL/key check is conditional on safe clipboard restore; packaged canonical-process client remains open. Stdio MCP sidecar and Windows COM IDispatch local server. Release ZIP: 25 entries, all three binaries match canonical outputs. Async jobs, measured query budgets and remaining AC03-09 resilience gates are open.
current_capabilities.external_vector_import: Real corpus verification: 4 CDR, 3 PDF, 1 PDF-compatible AI, and 2 EPS files imported to native objects, committed, and undone in test_pikdraw_desktop_import. CDR maps recognized layer IDs/transforms, shares raster previews, and carries each embedded image's original encoded bytes through RasterSourceChunk into immutable shared source metadata; RGBA8 preview preserves alpha, including PNG tRNS for RGB24/grayscale/indexed, while source metadata supports RGB24/RGBA32. PDF/AI profile v2 now preserves PDFium font family and PostScript base name into native TextObject; missing identity rejects instead of pretending Arial. PDF maps one tested OCG name and object marks when available; EPS imports path subset and converted DOS EPS. Import stops at 90% whole-system physical RAM with no fixed file-byte/pixel/process quota; U32 protocol/storage and other structural limits remain. Async imports capture target PageId; page navigation preserves job and commit target (AC-IPA12 partial). Document commands cover page rename/reorder/deep duplicate/resize with stable roots and Undo/Redo; resize now has bounds/no-change regression coverage, while Pages/Artboards UI is not verified. Focused raster adapter, CDR adapter corpus, worker integrity, shared-source native storage, and desktop corpus tests pass. Multi-page UI, font byte/glyph preservation, PDF effects/print lock/export, clipping/rotation, multi-OCG membership, Corel live effects, coordinate oracle fidelity, ICC/color rendering, source round-trip, production, and UI runtime remain unverified.

known_limitations: Qt 6 and Skia backends are future architectural targets pending unified MinGW/MSVC toolchain ABI; runtime currently standardizes on Win32 Native Shell + Direct2D 1.1 / D3D11 + WARP.

Interactive dragging reuses the cached native canvas and updates a small dirty copy when object bounds change; each changed snapshot is still fully rendered/read back by Direct2D. No GPU partial render, tile cache or direct swap-chain presentation is implemented.
DPI coverage uses synthetic 120/144/192/96 DPI events and native captures; physical monitor switching, reference-device latency and production fidelity remain unverified.
Autosave checkpoints use the UI writer synchronously; startup recovery selection UI is not implemented. Job Object memory/process/UI limits do not by themselves prove filesystem/network containment.

CDR uses pinned libcdr-to-SVG subset; PDF/AI are limited to first-page PDFium mapping and EPS uses eps-path-v1 or isolated Ghostscript conversion. PDF pages with nonzero rotation are rejected; effects/clipping, multiple OCG membership, Corel live effects, ICC fidelity, visual/coordinate oracle, all CDR versions, source round-trip, UI runtime, and production are not verified. Import monitors total physical RAM at a 90% stop threshold; structural/wire/time limits remain.
